AMD ROCm Ecosystem

AMD ROCm is an open software platform for GPU-accelerated computing. It empowers researchers and developers to build high-performance AI solutions across Instinct accelerators.

The latest ROCm release introduces native support for vLLM inference and optimized FP8 GEMM kernels on AMD Instinct MI300X GPUs, achieving significant latency improvements.

Key Hardware Specifications

The AMD Instinct MI300X features 192GB of HBM3 memory with a peak memory bandwidth of 5.3 TB/s.
